scope: Synthetic hospital CRUD mixed read/write HTTP workload, not AI inference throughput, clinical quality, full production traffic, or exclusive-host capacity. Both HTTP2xx and business code200 required.

plan.background_jobs: Two one-CPU backend regressions and other user workloads may remain active. Frontend/browser/model jobs paused.
plan.round_reset: TRUNCATE appointments only (no CASCADE), restore schedules=patients*2 and drug stock=max(history_rows*2,10000); preserve all other accumulated writes.

source_revision_note: Per-round Locust HEAD identifies test source only; deployed backend is bound by actual image IDs and runtime-image-manifest, and was frozen before retry development.
timing_note: Setup, account logins, target discovery, user ramp and2s warmup excluded from window. New tasks stop after configured60/300s; in-flight requests drain up to10s. rps uses generation window; rps_including_drain is the more conservative completed-request rate. CSV retains actual final counters.
monitor_note: Samples every2s. PG connection/transaction stats include the sampler connection and its read-only transaction. RSS sums can double-count shared pages; cgroup charged memory is authoritative.

workload_definition.appointment_capacity: Each schedule starts patients*2 to isolate compute/DB throughput from finite booking capacity.
workload_definition.stock_capacity: Each drug starts max(history_rows*2,10000); stocks and schedules restored between rounds.
